Pahaadon mein sukoon book kiya tha… traffic ka subscription mil gaya 😭🚗

Trying something funny + useful with AI: a weekend trip sanity check before we pack our bags.

Copy this prompt:
“I am travelling from [city] on [dates], with [people] and a budget of [amount]. Compare my original hill trip, a different-date option and a nearby day-trip backup. Ask about driving limits and flexibility. List what I must verify: current traffic, weather, official road advisories, hotel parking and cancellation terms. Do not invent live conditions, promise an empty road or suggest unverified mountain shortcuts.”

Use AI to organize options. Check live traffic and official updates yourself before leaving, and have a passenger check while travelling. Call the hotel about parking. Carry water, stay in your lane and follow police directions.

AI-generated illustrative scenery with animation—not real footage of Mussoorie or Rishikesh. The planner shown is an illustrative demo, not a live traffic service. Inspired by reports of the 2–4 October 2026 long-weekend rush.

Save this before your next trip. Who in your group always says “bas nikalte hain”? 😂
